intended_object: A reindexing bijection Fin (n+1) ≃ Fin 1 ⊕ Fin n that separates the first index from the rest (from the docstring). It is used to view an (n+1)×(n+1) matrix as a block matrix with a 1×1 pivot block.
explanation: This is a technical index-reindexing equivalence, built as finCongr (n+1 = 1+n) followed by finSumFinEquiv.symm. It sends 0 to the left summand and i+1 to i in the right summand, as the docstring says. It is a helper for the library's block-matrix pivot and diagonalization arguments, not a standard mathematical object, so it is not_a_mathematical_object.
